messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying our regional partners with the utmost care and quality. To continue serving you with the craftsmanship you expect from us, we must account for our rising expenses. Over the past twelve months, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost.

Taking these developments into consideration, we are pleased to present our offer for a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship deeply and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings (1)
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on hn volute casings.
Our order history for this part shows 126.53 EUR (po:4500013374-10) against 126.53 EUR in the latest order (po:4500014428-10).
Your letter gives 51 days' notice (doc:20260911-70110-P01), while our contract requires 90 days (ctr:4600070110), so the change cannot take effect on the date you announce.
Your rolling on-time delivery to 2026Q3 stands at 85.2% (sc:70110@2026Q3).
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 8,150 pcs per year over 12 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings (1)
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

We value your commitment to an annual volume of 8,150 pieces and accept the proposed 14-day payment terms. In exchange for these terms, we are pleased to reduce our offer to €134.20 per unit; however, please understand that we do not disclose internal cost breakdowns. Our costs move with LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351; the figures stay with us.

Our current offer stands at a price of €133.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Alternatively, with valid from 1 January 2027: a price of €134.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 January 2027.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
